ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible ventral surface exhibits a high contrast ratio; approximately 75% of pixels are high-intensity (white/light-gray) in the lobe interiors, while 25% are low-intensity (black) along the margins and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light-intensity regions occupy the center of both lobes. These are bounded by a solid black border along the trailing and outer edges. Numerous dark-pixel linear streaks (rake marks) are mapped across the light-intensity fields in various orientations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 45 degrees; the notch depth is approximately 20% of the total visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile with frequent low-amplitude (2-6 pixel) jaggedness interspersed with several medium-amplitude (10-15 pixel) notches, particularly on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curve along the trailing edge leading from the tips toward the median notch; leading edge transition to tips shows a convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, textured circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) are mapped at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected across the light ventral surface of both lobes, ranging from near-vertical to diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular chipping and jagged tissue loss visible along the trailing edges; extensive scarring in the form of multiple dark rake marks across the light-pigmented regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Concentrated area of high-density dark-pixel mottling and solid pigmentation at the convergence point where the fluke lobes meet the peduncle.
